Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, whereas NOWPayments charges a mere 0.5%. This disparity adds up quickly, with the fee [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-difference-between-choices-selling-digital-downloads-pakistan|The Real]] retaining $921 at 100 sales per month on a $97 product. The issue isn't just about fees; it's about infrastructure sovereignty, ownership, and the ability to collect payments directly from customers without relying on third-party services.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is a digital commerce architecture that enables creators to sell and deliver digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad. This means creators can accept payments directly from customers using cryptocurrency and automate the delivery of ebooks, courses, and other digital products. The architecture is built on NOWPayments, which provides a seamless and fee-efficient payment processing solution for creators. By deploying this architecture, creators can break free from platform fees and regain control over their sales data and customer relationships.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is built on a combination of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and NOWPayments. GitHub Pages hosts the digital store, while Cloudflare Workers handles the backend logic for automating ebook delivery. Supabase provides a free database for storing orders, and Google Drive is used for file delivery. NOWPayments integrates with the architecture to process payments in cryptocurrency, converting them to USD at transaction time. This setup ensures that creators can sell and deliver digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is designed for digital creators in regions where Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad are restricted or unavailable. It's ideal for those selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. By using this architecture, creators can regain control over their sales data and customer relationships, reduce fees, and increase their revenue. The architecture is built to be scalable, flexible, and adaptable to the needs of creators.
Digital creators can sell ebooks and courses without relying on Stripe or PayPal.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The architecture consists of the following components: GitHub Pages for hosting the digital store, Cloudflare Workers for automating ebook delivery, Supabase for storing orders, Google Drive for file delivery, and NOWPayments for processing payments in cryptocurrency. Each component works together seamlessly to provide a comprehensive digital commerce solution for creators. By using these components, creators can build a robust and scalable digital commerce stack that meets their needs.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this architecture today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. The kit is available for instant download and includes a comprehensive guide to deploying the architecture. Creators can then follow the checklist below to deploy the architecture and start selling and delivering digital products without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad.

The most important question a reader would ask is: 'Can I really sell ebooks and courses without using Stripe or PayPal?' The answer is yes. This means they can retain control over their sales data and customer relationships, reduce fees, and increase their revenue.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy the automated ebook delivery after crypto payment architecture, creators should follow these steps: Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) and download the kit. Review the comprehensive guide to deploying the architecture. Set up GitHub Pages for hosting the digital store. Configure Cloudflare Workers for automating ebook delivery. Integrate Supabase for storing orders and Google Drive for file delivery. Integrate NOWPayments for processing payments in cryptocurrency. Test the architecture to ensure seamless payment processing and ebook delivery.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I integrate NOWPayments with my digital store?

To integrate NOWPayments with your digital store, you'll need to set up a NOWPayments account and copy the payment script into your GitHub Pages site. This will enable seamless payment processing and ebook delivery. Make sure to configure the payment script to match your store's settings and test the integration to ensure it's working correctly.
Can I use this architecture with other types of digital products?

Yes, you can use this architecture with other types of digital products, such as courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. Simply configure the architecture to match the specific needs of your product and ensure that the payment processing and delivery mechanisms are working correctly.
How do I handle customer support and sales data with this architecture?

With this architecture, creators can handle customer support and sales data directly, without relying on third-party services. This means they can respond to customer inquiries, provide support, and analyze sales data without any limitations or fees.
Can I scale this architecture to meet the needs of a large customer base?

Yes, this architecture is designed to be scalable and adaptable to the needs of creators. By using Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, creators can handle a large volume of transactions and customer data without any issues.
What are the fees associated with using this architecture?
The fees associated with using this architecture are minimal, with NOWPayments charging a mere 0.5% on every sale. This is significantly lower than the fees charged by Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad.
